entities.name: Ergo 3.0x Loupe System
entities.description: Entry-level ergonomic loupe with 3.0x magnification, ideal for general dentistry

data.primary: The Ergo 3.0x combines classic design with modern optical technology. A versatile magnification level suitable for most dental and surgical procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Soul, Indie, and Jazz. Each frame comes in various colors to match your personal style. Features fixed declination angle optimized for standard working positions.

entities.name: Ergo 4.0x Loupe System
entities.description: Mid-range ergonomic loupe with 4.0x magnification for detailed procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 4.0x offers enhanced magnification for practitioners requiring greater detail visualization. Ideal for endodontics, restorative work, and surgical procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles including Blues, Soul, Indie, and Jazz. The increased magnification provides excellent detail while maintaining a comfortable field of view.

entities.name: Ergo 5.0x Loupe System
entities.description: High-magnification ergonomic loupe for precision dental and surgical work

data.primary: The Ergo 5.0x delivers exceptional magnification for demanding procedures requiring superior detail. Perfect for microsurgery, complex endodontics, and precision restorations.
data.secondary: Available in multiple frame styles. The 5.0x magnification provides outstanding visual clarity while the ergonomic design ensures comfort during extended procedures.

entities.name: Ergo 6.0x Loupe System
entities.description: Professional-grade 6.0x magnification for advanced clinical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 6.0x provides professional-grade magnification for specialists requiring exceptional detail visualization. Ideal for periodontal surgery, implantology, and complex restorative procedures.
data.secondary: Available in multiple premium frame styles. The advanced optics deliver crystal-clear images while maintaining a usable field of view and depth of field.

entities.name: Ergo 7.5x Loupe System
entities.description: High-performance 7.5x magnification for microsurgical procedures

data.primary: The Ergo 7.5x delivers high-performance magnification approaching microscope levels while maintaining the freedom of movement that loupes provide.
data.secondary: Designed for specialists in endodontics, periodontal microsurgery, and other disciplines requiring exceptional visual detail. Available in premium frame styles.

entities.name: Ergo 10x Loupe System
entities.description: Maximum magnification loupe system for the most demanding microsurgical applications

data.primary: The Ergo 10x represents the pinnacle of loupe magnification technology. Provides microscope-level detail while maintaining the ergonomic benefits and freedom of movement that loupes offer.
data.secondary: Designed for the most demanding applications in endodontic microsurgery, periodontal surgery, and specialized dental procedures. Available in premium frame styles.

entities.name: Ergo V Loupe System
entities.description: Next-generation ergonomic design with adjustable declination for optimal posture

data.primary: The Ergo V features Admetec's revolutionary adjustable declination system, allowing you to customize the viewing angle from 0° to 45° for optimal ergonomic posture.
data.secondary: Available in multiple magnification levels and frame styles. The Ergo V significantly reduces neck and back strain during extended procedures while maintaining exceptional optical clarity.

entities.name: Ergo V Pro Loupe System
entities.description: Premium version with integrated LED lighting and enhanced ergonomics

data.primary: The Ergo V Pro combines the revolutionary ergonomic design of the Ergo V with an integrated high-performance LED lighting system for complete visual enhancement.
data.secondary: Features adjustable declination, premium titanium frame, and wireless LED headlight delivering 55,000 lux. The complete solution for demanding clinical environments.

entities.name: Galilean 2.5x Loupe
entities.description: Lightweight Galilean loupes perfect for general dentistry and examinations

data.primary: The Galilean 2.5x offers an excellent entry point into magnification. The simple optical design provides a wide field of view and excellent depth of field.
data.secondary: Perfect for general examinations, hygiene procedures, and practitioners new to magnification. Ultra-lightweight design reduces neck strain. Available in multiple frame styles.

entities.name: Galilean 2.7x Loupe
entities.description: Popular mid-range Galilean loupe with excellent balance of magnification and comfort

data.primary: The Galilean 2.7x offers a step up in magnification while maintaining the lightweight comfort of Galilean optics. Ideal for practitioners seeking slightly more detail.
data.secondary: The most popular magnification choice among general practitioners. Provides excellent balance between magnification power and field of view.

entities.name: Galilean 3.2x Loupe
entities.description: Maximum magnification Galilean loupe for enhanced detail visualization

data.primary: The Galilean 3.2x provides the maximum magnification achievable with Galilean optics while maintaining their characteristic lightweight design.
data.secondary: Ideal for practitioners who need more magnification but prefer the wider field of view and lighter weight of Galilean technology over prismatic loupes.

entities.name: Anya AY-3000 Dental Chair
entities.description: Entry-level dental chair with essential features for modern dental practice

data.primary: The Anya AY-3000 is an entry-level dental chair that delivers excellent value without compromising on essential features. Perfect for new practices or satellite clinics.
data.secondary: Features smooth hydraulic movement, comfortable patient positioning, and reliable construction. Compatible with a wide range of delivery systems and accessories.

entities.name: Anya AY-6000 Dental Chair
entities.description: Mid-range dental chair with advanced features and enhanced ergonomics

data.primary: The Anya AY-6000 represents excellent value in the mid-range segment, offering advanced features typically found in premium chairs at a competitive price point.
data.secondary: Features programmable positions, integrated LED lighting, enhanced patient comfort with memory foam cushioning, and a comprehensive delivery system. Ideal for growing practices.

entities.name: Anya AY-8000 Premium Dental Chair
entities.description: Premium dental chair with top-tier features for discerning practitioners

data.primary: The Anya AY-8000 is the flagship dental chair offering uncompromising quality, advanced technology, and exceptional patient comfort for premium dental practices.
data.secondary: Features include touchscreen controls, integrated multimedia system, synchronized movements, premium leather upholstery with heating option, and advanced infection control features.

entities.name: Surgical Implant Motor
entities.description: Precision implant motor with advanced torque control for surgical procedures

data.primary: A precision surgical implant motor designed for dental implant placement and bone surgery. Features advanced torque control and programmable speed settings.
data.secondary: LED display shows real-time torque, speed, and irrigation status. Compatible with all major implant systems. Includes foot pedal control and comprehensive accessory kit.

entities.name: PTX Piezo Surgery Unit
entities.description: Advanced piezoelectric surgery unit for precise bone cutting

data.primary: The PTX Piezo Surgery Unit delivers precise, controlled bone cutting using ultrasonic vibration technology. Minimizes soft tissue damage while providing excellent visibility.
data.secondary: Ideal for implant site preparation, sinus lifts, bone grafting, and periodontal surgery. Features automatic frequency tuning and multiple power presets.

entities.name: Automatic Handpiece Lubricator
entities.description: Automated lubrication system for dental handpieces

data.primary: The Automatic Handpiece Lubricator ensures consistent, thorough lubrication of dental handpieces with the press of a button. Extends handpiece life and maintains performance.
data.secondary: Compatible with high-speed and low-speed handpieces. Programmable lubrication cycles ensure optimal oil distribution every time.

entities.name: Salli Ultra Saddle Chair
entities.description: Premium two-part saddle chair for optimal ergonomic posture

data.primary: The Salli Ultra features the innovative two-part saddle seat that allows unrestricted leg movement and promotes natural spinal curvature for all-day comfort.
data.secondary: Designed specifically for dental and medical professionals who spend long hours seated. The split seat design reduces pressure on soft tissues and improves circulation.

entities.name: Salli SwayFit Saddle Chair
entities.description: Dynamic saddle chair with lateral movement for active sitting

data.primary: The Salli SwayFit adds dynamic lateral movement to the proven saddle chair design, engaging core muscles and promoting active sitting throughout the day.
data.secondary: The swing mechanism allows natural side-to-side movement that keeps your body active while seated. Excellent for practitioners who want to combine comfort with gentle exercise.

entities.name: Salli TripleLift Saddle Chair
entities.description: Premium saddle chair with extended height range for standing-height work

data.primary: The Salli TripleLift features an extended height range that allows you to work at standing desk height while still benefiting from saddle seat support.
data.secondary: Perfect for sit-stand workstations and procedures that require varying heights. The three-stage gas lift provides smooth height adjustment throughout the full range.

entities.name: Medesy 700/8 Dental Elevator
entities.description: Premium Italian dental elevator for tooth luxation and extraction

data.primary: Medesy 700/8 elevator crafted from premium Italian stainless steel. Designed for efficient tooth luxation with optimal leverage and control.
data.secondary: Ergonomic handle design reduces hand fatigue during procedures. Mirror-polished finish for easy cleaning and sterilization.

entities.name: Medesy 710/1 Bein Elevator
entities.description: Classic Bein-style elevator for versatile extraction procedures

data.primary: The Medesy 710/1 Bein elevator features the classic curved blade design ideal for accessing difficult extraction sites.
data.secondary: Precision-ground blade edge ensures effective tooth luxation. The ergonomic handle provides excellent grip and control.

entities.name: Medesy 2500/17 Extraction Forceps
entities.description: Upper molar extraction forceps with anatomical beak design

data.primary: The Medesy 2500/17 forceps feature anatomically designed beaks for secure grip on upper molars during extraction procedures.
data.secondary: Precision joint mechanism ensures smooth operation. Spring-loaded handles reduce hand fatigue during multiple extractions.

entities.name: Medesy 2500/18 Extraction Forceps
entities.description: Lower molar extraction forceps with cow horn design

data.primary: The Medesy 2500/18 features the classic cow horn design optimized for lower molar extractions. The pointed beaks engage the furcation for controlled luxation.
data.secondary: Heavy-duty construction handles the increased forces required for lower molar extraction. Ergonomic handles provide secure grip.

entities.name: Medesy 1300/6 Periosteal Elevator
entities.description: Double-ended periosteal elevator for tissue reflection

data.primary: The Medesy 1300/6 is a double-ended periosteal elevator designed for efficient soft tissue reflection during surgical procedures.
data.secondary: Features both broad and narrow ends for versatility in different surgical situations. Smooth edges minimize tissue trauma.

entities.name: Medesy 3500/14 Surgical Scissors
entities.description: Curved surgical scissors for soft tissue procedures

data.primary: The Medesy 3500/14 curved surgical scissors feature precision-ground blades for clean, accurate tissue cutting.
data.secondary: The curved design provides excellent visibility and access in the oral cavity. Smooth joint action for fatigue-free operation.

entities.name: Strauss A-Series Carbide Burs
entities.description: Round carbide burs for cavity preparation and access

data.primary: Strauss A-Series round carbide burs are precision-manufactured in Switzerland for consistent performance and longevity.
data.secondary: Ideal for caries removal, cavity preparation, and endo access. Available in multiple sizes from A0 to A9. Sharp cutting edges ensure efficient tooth structure removal.

entities.name: Strauss B-Series Carbide Burs
entities.description: Pear-shaped carbide burs for cavity preparation

data.primary: Strauss B-Series pear-shaped carbide burs provide excellent control for cavity preparation and undercut creation.
data.secondary: The pear shape allows for efficient bulk material removal while maintaining precision. Available in multiple sizes.

entities.name: Strauss C-Series Carbide Burs
entities.description: Inverted cone carbide burs for undercut preparation

data.primary: Strauss C-Series inverted cone burs excel at creating retentive undercuts and flat cavity floors.
data.secondary: Essential for amalgam cavity preparation. The inverted cone shape provides excellent mechanical retention.

entities.name: Strauss D-Series Diamond Burs
entities.description: Round diamond burs for enamel and dentin preparation

data.primary: Strauss D-Series round diamond burs feature premium diamond coating for smooth, efficient cutting of enamel and dentin.
data.secondary: Excellent for crown preparation, caries removal, and finishing. Available in coarse, medium, and fine grits.

entities.name: Strauss E-Series Diamond Burs
entities.description: Egg-shaped diamond burs for crown preparation

data.primary: Strauss E-Series egg-shaped diamond burs are designed for efficient crown preparation and occlusal reduction.
data.secondary: The unique shape provides excellent access and visibility while reducing enamel efficiently.

entities.name: Strauss F-Series Finishing Burs
entities.description: Flame-shaped finishing burs for margin refinement

data.primary: Strauss F-Series flame-shaped burs are ideal for interproximal preparation and margin finishing.
data.secondary: The tapered flame shape provides excellent access to tight spaces while maintaining control.

entities.name: Strauss Crown Preparation Kit
entities.description: Complete bur kit for crown and bridge preparation

data.primary: The Strauss Crown Preparation Kit contains all essential burs for efficient crown and bridge preparation in one convenient package.
data.secondary: Includes round, egg, tapered, and finishing burs in multiple grits. Organized in a reusable sterilizable bur block.

entities.name: Strauss Endodontic Access Kit
entities.description: Specialized bur kit for endodontic access preparation

data.primary: The Strauss Endodontic Access Kit provides all necessary burs for efficient endodontic access cavity preparation.
data.secondary: Includes round carbide burs for initial penetration, tapered fissure burs for access refinement, and safe-ended burs for pulp chamber entry.
